text:
Alex: Hi team — Highridge POC kickoff. They want SSO (SAML2), SCIM user sync, RBAC roles + domain proofing. Also asking for audit log retention, EU-only data residency, and a pricing ballpark for reserved capacity. Can someone run the preflight checklist?
Maria: I can take the SAML/SCIM tech checks. Quick notes: their IdP only supports SHA256 signatures and wants signed assertions + encrypted responses. We should confirm ACS URL and SP Entity ID.
Alex: Cool. Customer asked about session timeout mapping — they want SSO session to map to app session (idle timeout 30m). Any constraints?
Maria: We map IdP session expiration to our session by default but need to enable `enforce_sso_session` in route config. I can paste sample config: `saml: {acs: "https://staging.redwood-inference.com/saml/acs/highridge", entity_id: "redwood:highridge:staging", signature_alg: "rsa-sha256"}`
Jess: For the POC timeline they want end-to-end in 2 weeks. Actions: 1) Get SAML metadata from Highridge, 2) Provide SCIM test creds + recommended rate limits, 3) Create staging tenant with EU region, 4) Outline Dedicated capacity quote.
Sam: Security asks: SOC2 + PCI scope? They specified audit logs with 1yr retention, field-level change history for role grants, and KMS-backed key management for at-rest encryption. We need to confirm if EU-region control plane meets their legal team.
Maria: SCIM notes: we support both bulk delta and incremental sync. Default rate limit is 60 req/min per tenant; for large orgs we can increase on Dedicated. Delta sync uses `GET /scim/v2/Users?filter=...` and we include `meta.lastModified`. If their IdP sends large SCIM pushes we recommend chunking.
Alex: Pricing: can you give a ballpark for Reserved capacity 2-week POC? They expect an enterprise price sheet.
Jess: Ballpark: for a POC sized ~10-20k monthly gen tokens + SCIM + dedicated staging (single small GPU pool) we usually quote a short-term commit ~ $10k/month for reserved. Exact depends on concurrency/latency targets. Mark as estimate.
Sam: Also: request for audit export. We can deliver daily S3 exports (EU region) containing anonymized token-level usage + admin audit trail. Need legal to confirm PII rules.
Maria: Technical blocker: their IdP will only sign using SHA1 for logout requests. Logout requests are optional for POC — we can disable SP-initiated logout to avoid failing signature checks. Flagging this for preflight.
Alex: OK — action items captured. Who's owning the SAML metadata validation? @Maria
Maria: I'll validate metadata and create a staging SP config. I'll also send sample SCIM test user CSV and a small script they can run: ```curl -u test:pass -X GET 'https://staging.redwood-inference.com/scim/v2/Users'```
deploy-bot: Ticket #REDWOOD-4521 created for Highridge POC onboarding (owner: Maria) :white_check_mark:
Jess: I'll assemble an email for the customer inc. staging endpoints, pricing estimate, and the security checklist for Sam to sign off. Target send EOD tomorrow.
Sam: I'll run the security checklist and confirm KMS/HSM options and audit export SLA by EOD tomorrow.
Alex: Thanks — I'll schedule a 30m sync with Highridge for Thurs 10am GMT. Please add the staging URLs once Maria has them. :thumbsup:
Maria: Will do. Adding a note — ask Highridge to create a test user in their IdP with these attributes: `email`, `externalId`, `name.familyName`, `roles` (SCIM extension). That will speed verification.
Alex: Perfect. Closing thread for now, will reopen after metadata is in.
